pcr-muscle.label: Phosphocreatine (PCr) in resting skeletal muscle
pcr-muscle.value: about 80 mmol·kg⁻¹ dry muscle (about two thirds of total creatine)

total-creatine-muscle.label: Total creatine (PCr + free creatine) in muscle, normal diet
total-creatine-muscle.value: about 120 mmol·kg⁻¹ dry muscle (upper limit about 160 after loading)

atp-per-glucose.label: ATP from full oxidation of one glucose
atp-per-glucose.value: about 30–32 ATP (2 net from glycolysis alone; 3 per glucose unit from glycogen)

atp-per-palmitate.label: ATP from full oxidation of one palmitate (16-carbon fatty acid)

gross-efficiency-cycling.label: Gross efficiency in cycling
gross-efficiency-cycling.value: about 20% (20.2% and 20.5% in two lab studies of men)

adipose-energy.label: Energy stored in adipose tissue, lean athlete (7–14% body fat)
